attribution.known_gap: revid is null in all 940 tier-1 snapshots: the fetcher requested rvprop=timestamp|user|comment|content and omitted 'ids', so no revision id was ever returned. No re-fetch was performed for this tier. Attribution is therefore pinned by source_url + revision timestamp + content sha256 rather than by oldid.
attribution.license_note: English Wikipedia article text fetched 2026-09-29 is licensed CC BY-SA 4.0; individual revisions may carry older dual terms (CC BY-SA 3.0/GFDL) — see per-article revid/timestamp/source_url for exact attribution.

caps.sentence_omission: none: all sentences preserved as nodes

builder.determinism: pure function of raw bytes + candidate list + builder bytes + core corpus bytes + revision; no clock, no PRNG
builder.network: none: the offline path never calls api_get/fetch_article

core_reference.direction: one-directional: this tier cites the core; the core cites nothing about scale

disk_footprint.note: Raw snapshots dominate disk use. Every other built artifact's exact byte size is pinned in scale_build_manifest.json, which is written after this file. corpus/scale/raw/ is git-ignored and recoverable only while the per-file hashes in this manifest still match.

measurement_scope: ALL scale measurements are DESKTOP measurements. No Android or on-device performance claim may be derived from anything in this tier.

merged_view.definition: canonical corpus hash over the union of core nodes and scale nodes; the two roots coexist because their namespaces are disjoint

role: IRRELEVANT DISTRACTOR MATERIAL. This tier carries no evidence, is not part of any question set, and exists only to provide background mass for scale/regime experiments. The 297-article core corpus is the only evidence-bearing semantic base.

selection_independence.attestation: PROCEDURAL, NOT EMPIRICAL. The 960-title candidate list was frozen in corpus/scale/distractor_candidates.json before any fetch and before any question construction, with seed 'scale-v1', and its method string declares it independent of benchmark answers. No scale title was chosen by looking at a held-out answer, and no scale article is evidence-bearing. This is a procedural guarantee about a curated list; it is not a statistical independence test.
selection_independence.candidate_method: Hand-curated candidate list frozen BEFORE any fetch or question creation. Scale tier - distractor only. Seed scale-v1. Excludes core 297 titles.
selection_independence.verification_method: mechanical set intersection on pageid, normalized title (bp.norm_key), and content sha256 against all 297 core article nodes
